complexity: Cyclomatic complexity V(G) = 6 - 6 + 2 = 2. One explicit mismatch decision also gives 1 + 1 = 2.

notes: The stale branch can follow tentative mutation of a transaction-loaded object. Assert that persisted state is unchanged and no ledger/save effect commits; do not claim that no in-memory preparation happened.

The 30 removal application tests also cover missing records, access, non-committed targets, exact start, unrelated changes, replay and append/save/commit failures. Those use in-memory transaction doubles and do not establish PostgreSQL atomicity.
